claims.value: Unlimited OCR 2 is a multilingual vision-language model for OCR that achieves unlimited-horizon parsing using Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA). It supports multi-page inference with cross-page context and is available via Transformers and SGLang.
claims.evidence: Unlimited-OCR 2 achieves true, unbounded document parsing within a finite context window... Achieves state-of-the-art performance across both dozens-of-pages benchmarks
